sentences.text: Malta -LRB- -LSB- ˈmɒltə -RSB- -LSB- ˈmɐltɐ -RSB- -RRB- , officially known as the Republic of Malta -LRB- Repubblika ta ' Malta -RRB- , is a Southern European island country consisting of an archipelago in the Mediterranean Sea .	island country	island country	archipelago	archipelago	Mediterranean Sea	Mediterranean Sea
It lies 80 km south of Italy , 284 km east of Tunisia , and 333 km north of Libya .	Italy	Italy	Tunisia	Tunisia	Libya	Libya

The country covers just over 316 km2 , with a population of just under 450,000 , making it one of the world 's smallest and most densely populated countries .	smallest	Microstate	most densely populated	List of countries by population density

The capital of Malta is Valletta , which at 0.8 km2 , is the smallest national capital in the European Union by area .	European Union	European Union	Valletta	Valletta	smallest	Microstate	national capital	national capital

Malta has one national language , which is Maltese , and English as an official language .	Maltese	Maltese language	English	English language	national language	national language	official	state religion

Malta 's location in the middle of the Mediterranean has historically given it great strategic importance as a naval base , and a succession of powers , including the Phoenicians , Carthaginians , Greeks , Romans , Byzantines , Moors , Normans , Sicilians , Spanish , Knights of St. John , French and British , have ruled the islands .	Carthaginians	Ancient Carthage	Greeks	Greeks	Romans	Ancient Rome	Byzantines	Byzantine Greeks	Moors	Emirate of Sicily	Normans	County of Sicily	Sicilians	Kingdom of Sicily	Spanish	Habsburg Spain	Knights of St. John	Knights Hospitaller	French	French First Republic	British	British Empire

King George VI of the United Kingdom awarded the George Cross to Malta in 1942 for the country 's bravery in the Second World War .	United Kingdom	United Kingdom	King George VI	George VI	awarded the George Cross to Malta	award of the George Cross to Malta	Second World War	Second World War	George Cross	George Cross
The George Cross continues to appear on Malta 's national flag .	George Cross	George Cross

Under the Malta Independence Act , passed by the British Parliament in 1964 , Malta gained independence from the United Kingdom as an independent sovereign Commonwealth realm , officially known from 1964 to 1974 as the State of Malta , with Elizabeth II as its head of state .	United Kingdom	United Kingdom	Commonwealth realm	Commonwealth realm	British	British Empire	British Parliament	British Parliament	State of Malta	State of Malta	Elizabeth II	Elizabeth II

The country became a republic in 1974 , and although no longer a Commonwealth realm , remains a member state of the Commonwealth of Nations .	republic	republic	Commonwealth realm	Commonwealth realm	member state	Member states of the Commonwealth of Nations	Commonwealth of Nations	Commonwealth of Nations

Malta was admitted to the United Nations in 1964 and to the European Union in 2004 ; in 2008 , it became part of the Eurozone .	European Union	European Union	United Nations	United Nations	Eurozone	Eurozone

Malta has a long Christian legacy and its Archdiocese of Malta is claimed to be an apostolic see because , according to Acts of the Apostles , St Paul was shipwrecked on `` Melita '' , now widely taken to be Malta .	Christian	Christian	Archdiocese of Malta	Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Malta	apostolic see	apostolic see	Acts of the Apostles	Acts of the Apostles	St Paul	Paul the Apostle
Catholicism is the official religion in Malta .	Catholicism	Catholic Church	official	state religion	religion in Malta	religion in Malta

Malta is a popular tourist destination with its warm climate , numerous recreational areas , and architectural and historical monuments , including three UNESCO World Heritage Sites : Ħal Saflieni Hypogeum , Valletta , and seven Megalithic Temples , which are some of the oldest free-standing structures in the world .
